title: How to get to Matsumoto — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The city guide lists Azusa limited express services from Shinjuku and Shinano services from Nagoya as rail approaches.
facts.excerpt: Access from the Tokyo area: JR East Limited Express Train Azusa

facts.fact: For the Nagoya approach, the city lists the Shinano limited express; travellers from Osaka or Kyoto change at Nagoya in the described route.
facts.excerpt: Access from Nagoya, Osaka, and Kyoto area: JR Central Limited Express Train Shinano
facts.location: Access by rail > Nagoya, Osaka and Kyoto area

facts.fact: The municipal article is explicitly dated19March2026, and recommends consulting rail operators and current reservation arrangements.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
